title: パリへ、ひとつの勇気 · Brave in Paris
description: Morning at the Louvre, a breeze in the gardens of Versailles, clouds above the Arc de Triomphe, and the glow of the opera. Aya finds a little more courage with every step through Paris. Far away, someone misses her dearly, but waves her onward: don't hurry home; go meet the self you've yet to know.
caption: 会いたいな。でも、君の冒険に手を振るよ。
